# OpenDDIL Edge SDK (Python) — llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org/

> OpenDDIL Edge SDK for Python manages the local SQLite Outbox on Edge devices.
> Events are serialized as Protobuf binaries and spooled locally for eventual flush to HQ.

## Project Purpose
Client-side SDK for DDIL environments. All writes go to a local SQLite Outbox.
No network calls are made during event creation — the Relay handles sync.

## Architecture
- Write Path: UI → InventoryOperations → OutboxManager → SQLite Outbox → Relay → Redpanda
- Read Path: ElectricSQL → SQLite Read-Cache → UI (handled separately)
- Events are wrapped in CloudEvent envelopes (from openddil-contracts)
- Payload is serialized Protobuf binary (BLOB in SQLite)

## Key Files
- src/openddil_edge/outbox_manager.py: Core Outbox manager (enqueue, get_pending_events, mark_as_processed).
- src/openddil_edge/inventory_operations.py: High-level allocate_inventory() wrapper for UI developers.
- src/openddil_edge/relay_agent.py: Async background agent that flushes Outbox to Redpanda (exponential backoff, Zstd compression).
- src/openddil_edge/__init__.py: Package init.
- sql/outbox_schema.sql: SQLite schema for outbox_events table.

## Dependencies
- sqlite3 (stdlib): SQLite access.
- protobuf: Protobuf serialization (pip install protobuf).
- aiokafka: Async Kafka/Redpanda producer (pip install aiokafka).
- Generated Python classes from openddil-contracts (make python).

## Outbox Table Schema
- id: TEXT PRIMARY KEY (UUID v4)
- event_type: TEXT NOT NULL (CloudEvent type URI)
- payload_bytes: BLOB NOT NULL (serialized CloudEvent Protobuf)
- created_at: TEXT NOT NULL (ISO 8601 UTC)
- is_processed: INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 (0=pending, 1=flushed)

## Python Conventions
- Uses stdlib sqlite3 only (no SQLAlchemy or other ORMs).
- WAL journal mode enabled for better concurrent access.
- Context manager support (with statement).
- snake_case naming throughout.
